comment: I had Prof. Heen for Federal Income Tax. While the material is difficult, Prof. Heen makes it easy to grasp. Her teaching style is effective for the subject, and I left her class happy that I took it. I would certainly recommend her to a friend if they wanted to take Federal Income Tax.

Professor Heen is incredibly knowledgeable about tax and always willing to answer questions during or after class.  She always strives to explain each topic very clearly, which is exceptionally difficult given the complexity of tax issues.  Tax is hard, but Professor Heen makes the material accessible.  You will learn a lot of useful information.

She cares a lot about attendance but the exam is only on the last 1/3 of the class. She goes very fast and just regurgitates information from the book in her power point. She expects you to have a base knowledge of how government works and bills become laws, etc.
The class killed me. Makes no sense and taught by the worst professor ever. She is smart but absolutely a bad professor. The exam is close book.

Avoid if possible. Prof. Heen fakes being nice and understanding and will fool you into thinking she is a little lamb; she's not.   Attendance is VERY VERY important to her (even thought she won't say so in the first class). Late? you'd better not, she'll write down how late you were even during make up classes.  Lectures are awful too. AVOID.
